# Example firmware: the generated static library plus the ATmega328P main.
# The generated pair is emitted at build time into the build tree, so no
# generated bytes live in the repository.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(custom_firmware C)

# The in-tree core checkout; an out-of-tree copy passes its own -DR2S_CORE_DIR.
if(NOT R2S_CORE_DIR)
  set(R2S_CORE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../core")
endif()
if(NOT R2S_GENERATED_DIR)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "R2S_GENERATED_DIR names no generated directory "
    "(emit it with r2s-gen generate --layout cmake)")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${R2S_GENERATED_DIR}" generated)

# The generated library compiles the core, and its flags carry only the codec
# and the limits. The services and actions channels are build-wide switches, so
# they join that target: a definition added here reaches the core sources it
# compiles and, being PUBLIC, this firmware too.
target_compile_definitions(r2s_generated PUBLIC R2S_WITH_SERVICES R2S_WITH_ACTIONS)

add_executable(custom_firmware.elf main.c)
target_link_libraries(custom_firmware.elf PRIVATE r2s_generated)
target_compile_options(custom_firmware.elf PRIVATE
    -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wconversion -Wshadow
    -Wstrict-prototypes -Wmissing-prototypes -Wundef)
